title: Same-Day Confirmed Change — Desk Guidance for Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Desk guidance — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** A same-day confirmed change moves the passenger to another Crestline flight between the same origin and destination, on the same calendar date as the original flight and in the same cabin, without any fare difference.

## When it is available

- Only when the ticket's fare brand sells a same-day confirmed change.
- No earlier than the scheduled departure of the flight being changed minus the fare brand's same-day window hours. The window opens a full window-length of elapsed hours before the next scheduled departure on the ticket, and a request at exactly the opening moment is accepted.
- Before the original flight departs.

| Original departure 16:00 on day 2, 24-hour window (hypothetical) | Request |
|---|---|
| 15:59 on day 1 | Too early; the window is not yet open |
| 16:00 on day 1 | Accepted (opening moment) |
| 15:30 on day 2 | Accepted |
| After 16:00 on day 2, the flight having departed | Not available |

## The fee

The former clause setting the fee at the fare brand's same-day confirmed change fee per passenger per direction, recorded as a same-day change fee entry linked to the exchange entry, is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current same-day change fee basis.

The fee is waived when the passenger's Summit membership tier waives the same-day change fee in the loyalty program's terms, or when the ticket's corporate agreement waives change fees; a waived fee is not recorded.

## What it never does

A same-day change never generates an add-collect or a residual. A request that changes the origin, destination, date or cabin is a voluntary change instead.

superseded_clauses: The fee is same_day_confirmed_change_fee per passenger per direction, recorded as a same_day_change_fee entry linked to the exchange entry.
